channel.title: Hürriyet Daily News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Hürriyet Daily News (hurriyetdailynews.com)

item.title: Türkiye seizes $2.2 bln worth of smuggled goods this year
item.description: Turkish customs authorities seized smuggled goods worth 98.5 billion Turkish Liras (around $2.2 billion) in 2025, a 79 percent increase compared with the previous year, Trade Minister Ömer Bolat has said.

item.title: Türkiye names ‘digital conscience’ as 2025 word of the year
item.description: Türkiye’s state language authority has named “digital conscience,” rendered in Turkish as “dijital vicdan,” as its word of the year for 2025, following a nationwide public vote that drew nearly 300,000 votes, the country’s culture minister announced on Dec. 29.

item.title: Snow sculpture completed in Kars ahead of Sarıkamış Campaign anniversary
item.description: Authorities in Türkiye’s eastern province of Kars have completed one of two snow sculptures being prepared as part of commemorative events marking the 111th anniversary of the Sarıkamış Campaign, one of the most tragic episodes of World War I for the Ottoman army.

item.title: Türkiye shaken 6 times an hour as 2025 sees over 53,000 earthquakes
item.description: Türkiye was shaken by 53,262 earthquakes this year, a rhythm that translates into six tremors every hour and 146 each day, making 2025 the second most seismically active year since the devastating Feb. 6, 2023 earthquakes that hit the country’s south.

item.title: China fires rockets on second day of military drills around Taiwan
item.description: China launched missiles and deployed dozens of fighter aircraft and navy vessels around Taiwan on Tuesday for a second day of live-fire drills aimed at simulating a blockade of the self-ruled island's key ports and assaults on maritime targets.

item.title: Moscow says Kiev fired drones at Putin residence
item.description: Russia on Dec. 29 accused Kiev of firing drones at Vladimir Putin's residence between Moscow and Saint Petersburg, announcing it would "revise" its negotiating position on ending the Ukraine war after the "terrorist attack."

item.title: Spain inks deal to purchase 30 units of Turkish jet trainer HURJET
item.description: Spain signed an agreement with Türkiye for purchasing 30 units of the Turkish jet trainer aircraft HURJET, worth €2.4 billion ($2.8 billion), the head of Türkiye's Defense Industries Secretariat announced on Monday.

item.title: Trump says Türkiye and Israel will ‘not have a problem’
item.description: U.S. President Donald Trump said Monday that Türkiye and Israel will not have a problem, dismissing concerns over potential conflict as he spoke alongside Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu at a joint news conference in Florida.

item.title: Türkiye captures over 350 ISIL terrorists as raids stepped up after Yalova clash
item.description: Turkish security forces on Dec. 30 intensified nationwide operations against the ISIL terrorist organization following the killing of three police officers during a counterterrorism raid in the northeastern province of Yalova, detaining 357 suspects across 21 provinces.

item.title: Israel's decision to recognize Somaliland illegitimate, unacceptable: Erdoğan
item.description: Israel's decision to recognize Somaliland is illegitimate and unacceptable, the Turkish president said on Dec. 30.
